entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Yeah, yeah, just get me a person. This is unbelievable.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return this piece of junk VeloBand you sold me. It's completely broken and I want my money back immediately.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into that for you. To get started, can I please have your name and order number?
The name is Marcus Cole, order number VF887-21B. And don't waste my time.

Okay, thank you, Marcus. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To best help you, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

A technical fault? The thing is completely defective! It's been not working properly since I got it. The heart rate monitor is a joke, and it won't sync with the app at all. I paid for a working device, not a useless wrist decoration.
I understand your frustration. A device that won't sync is certainly not the experience we want for our customers. I see you've had the device for 20 days now...

I don't care if I've had it for 20 days or 20 minutes! You sold me a broken product. Are you going to process my refund or do I need to speak to your manager? I swear I will write a review on every website I can find about this disaster.

That won't be necessary, Marcus. Let me just double-check our return policy for you right now... one moment... Okay, I've confirmed it. Our knowledge base shows that all VeloFit items are eligible for a return within 90 days of delivery.
90 days? Fine. I'm within the window. So process the return and give me my money back.

Absolutely. Since the item is defective and you're well within that 90-day period, I have approved the return for a full refund. I'm sending you a prepaid return label to your email on file right now. Just attach it to the original packaging and you can drop it off at any post office.
Okay. A prepaid label is the least you could do. Finally. You should have just done that from the start instead of giving me a hard time.
I do apologize for the trouble, Marcus. The email has been sent. Will there be anything else for you today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
